label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be _____,
verse: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
note: A mystery revealed — not everyone will die, but everyone will be changed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy _____, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
verse: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
note: To sick King Hezekiah: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears — and God added fifteen years.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the _____ of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verse: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
note: John is told to look at the Lion of Juda — and when he turns, he sees a Lamb (Revelation 5:6).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had _____ for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
note: David's lament over Absalom, the son who tried to steal his throne — victory news that broke his heart.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the _____ of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verse: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
note: 'Sleight' as in sleight of hand — trickery, not 'slight.' Paul warns against doctrine dealt by card sharps.
